turns: On d1, count HR.JOB_HISTORY records grouped by JOB_ID and show all groups ordered by JOB_ID.

For those same history records and grouping, now show JOB_ID and average END_DATE minus START_DATE in days, rounded to exactly two decimal places. Keep the same ordering and show all groups; use history intervals rather than current employees' tenure.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT job_id,TO_CHAR(ROUND(AVG(end_date-start_date),2),'FM999999990.00') FROM hr.job_history GROUP BY job_id ORDER BY job_id
